_comment: Registry of the platform documentation corpus (GitHub issue #4). Each entry maps a repo doc to its bundled route: scripts/build-docs.mjs renders it at BUILD time and the Worker serves it at /docs/<name>, so an instance's documentation always matches its own deployed build. `name` is the route segment and must be unique. `seed: true` additionally publishes the doc into the corpus as a Document under the reserved slug `slopcafe-docs-<name>`, so MCP agents can reach it with read_document / search_documents / load_context_pack; seed ONLY what a tool description or discovery document instructs an agent to read — everything else is a route. `description`/`tags` are corpus metadata and are only meaningful for seeded entries. This file replaced the old publish-and-promote mirror: there are no per-instance public_ids here any more, which is what makes the registry identical on every deployment.

docs.name: http-api-quickstart
docs.description: The five-minute HTTP on-ramp: base URL, the auth header, and the four routes a script needs to publish, update, read and list documents without the MCP tools. Companion to the byte-exact curl path.

docs.name: publishing-guide
docs.description: The Slopcafe document authoring contract: what HTML/CSS/SVG survives sanitization (static-only, inline styles, inline SVG, the allowed tag/attribute list, the URL-scheme allowlist, and the table of what is silently stripped), plus the Markdown input path. Read before publishing anything with layout or visuals.
